# M1: Data exploration card

Copy to `docs/m1-exploration-card.md` and fill in. Graded on: concreteness of the question, quality of exploration, coherence of the plan.

## 1. Research question and hypothesis
- Question (one testable thesis):
- Hypothesis, and what result would falsify it:
- Outcome proxy (match / co-interest in the same listing) and why it is not equal to the real decision:

## 2. Data sources
- Source, owner, access terms, date received:
- Unit of analysis and keys (consistency across tables confirmed? yes/no):
- Sample scope (users, profiles, swipes, matches, chats):

- Counts and distributions (swipes per user, match rate by gender pair and age gap, missingness):
- Bio audit for personal data:
- Plots / tables (link to notebook or script):

## 4. Measurement plan

- AI instrument (if any) and how it will be validated against the gold standard (see codebook):

- Selection (active users only), homophily vs. preference, asymmetry of swipes, other:
